title: drymocallis lactea
intro: Drymocallis lactea, commonly known as White Avens, is a perennial plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). The plant is rich in medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. White Avens is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, colds, and fever. The bioactive constituents of White Avens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections.
